GP Rating Course: Fees, Eligibility & Career Scope

What GP Rating actually prepares you for, what the full fee sheet should include, and how to verify a safe next step after Class 10.

By National Global Academy Editorial TeamPublished 22 January 2026 • Updated 10 November 2026

Check Your Eligibility

GP Rating—General Purpose Rating—is an entry pathway toward rating work in a merchant vessel’s deck and engine departments. It can suit students seeking hands-on work after Class 10. The key is to understand what the recognised course covers, what you must spend beyond tuition, and why certification does not automatically produce a ship job.

What is the GP Rating course?

GP Rating preparation introduces foundational seamanship, engine-room awareness, safety and shipboard routines. Ratings work under supervision and develop practical experience. The recognised pre-sea programme and associated certification should be verified against current DG Shipping information and the institution delivering it.

National Global Academy’s pathway support should be distinguished from any external certifying provider. [CONFIRM: Insert NGA’s exact academic/certification role here before using this paragraph as final programme copy.]

GP Rating course eligibility

Eligibility generally involves Class 10 education plus age, subject/marks, medical and vision requirements. The exact criteria must be checked against current DG Shipping guidelines and the recognised institution’s current admission notice.

  • Verify minimum academic qualification and marks, including English where specified.
  • Confirm age on the relevant admission date and any permitted relaxation.
  • Investigate eyesight, colour vision and physical fitness early.
  • Keep recognised-board marksheets, identity and age records consistent.
Important: meeting a consultant’s admission criteria does not override an official medical or certification standard. A small early verification cost can prevent a much larger wrong investment.

GP Rating course fees: build a complete budget

Cost headQuestion to ask
Tuition / preparationWho receives it, what does it include and is tax extra?
Registration / admissionIs it adjustable against tuition and is it refundable?
Hostel and foodIs it mandatory, for how many months and what facilities are included?

Always obtain a receipt and refund terms. A “fully included” claim should list the inclusions.

What do you learn?

Preparation can cover basic seamanship, ropes and deck routines, machinery awareness, maintenance support, maritime English, mathematics, safety culture and physical readiness. Practical hours and facilities matter as much as module names. [CONFIRM: Add verified hours and lab/practical details for NGA’s delivered programme.]

Career scope after GP Rating

After required recognised training and certification, candidates can seek suitable deck or engine rating opportunities. Selection depends on documents, performance and vacancies. With applicable sea service, experience and further certification, longer-term progression may be possible; it is not automatic.

New rating/trainee compensation is commonly discussed around ₹20,000–₹60,000 per month while onboard. These are indicative industry ranges, not guaranteed earnings. Shore leave or waiting periods may be unpaid, and the employer and vessel can change compensation.

How to choose an institute safely

  1. Verify the institution and exact course using current official information.
  2. Ask who awards each certificate and who provides any sea-time opportunity.
  3. Review practical facilities, instructors and attendance requirements.
  4. Get the complete fee, hostel and refund sheet.
  5. Reject any “100% job” or “pay extra for joining” claim.
  6. Talk to recent alumni directly where possible, with consent and independent verification.

Straight answers

Quick answers to common questions.

Save this guide and discuss it with your family before applying.

Is GP Rating available after 10th?

It is commonly explored after Class 10, subject to current academic, age and medical requirements. Verify exact criteria with the recognised institution.

Does GP Rating guarantee a ship job?

No. Required training and certification support eligibility to seek roles; selection and joining depend on recruitment, documents and vacancies.

Can girls pursue GP Rating?

Women can pursue maritime pathways where current course and employer criteria are met. Verify facilities, workplace policies and support systems directly.
